totals.at_risk_rule: Per entry: largest single reduction among open findings, capped at the entry amount. Invoice: the larger of the per-entry sum and the largest invoice-level amount, capped at the sum of the lines.

findings.entry_narrative: Telephone conference with general counsel regarding litigation budget
findings.source_quote: Submit time within 45 days of the work; older time is written off.
findings.explanation: The work is dated 2026-09-10, 56 days before the invoice date. The limit is 45 days.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the client whether it will accept the late time, or write it off.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft claim chart for the 412 patent family
findings.rule_label: AI-assisted work must be disclosed on the invoice
findings.source_quote: If any work billed to us was performed with the assistance of a generative artificial intelligence tool, the time entry must be marked "[AI-assisted]" on the invoice.
findings.source_ref: Schedule B: Use of artificial intelligence tools, page 2
findings.explanation: The entry is flagged as AI-assisted in the time system but the narrative does not carry the client's disclosure marker "[AI-assisted]".
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm with the timekeeper whether AI assistance was used. If so, add "[AI-assisted]" to the entry.

findings.source_quote: General overhead, including research database subscriptions and word processing, is not chargeable.
findings.explanation: This expense looks like an overhead item the client does not reimburse ("subscription").
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the expense from the bill.

findings.entry_narrative: Summarize deposition transcript of lead engineer [AI-assisted]
findings.rule_label: Client will not pay for certain AI-assisted tasks
findings.source_quote: We will not pay for AI-assisted summaries of transcripts or documents, or for AI-assisted first-pass document review.
findings.source_ref: Schedule B: Use of artificial intelligence tools, page 2
findings.explanation: The entry is AI-assisted and describes a task ("Summarize") that this client's terms say it will not pay for when AI-assisted.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the entry off the bill, or raise it with the client before billing.

findings.entry_narrative: Review output of generative AI tool for prior art search
findings.rule_label: AI-assisted work must be disclosed on the invoice
findings.source_quote: If any work billed to us was performed with the assistance of a generative artificial intelligence tool, the time entry must be marked "[AI-assisted]" on the invoice.
findings.source_ref: Schedule B: Use of artificial intelligence tools, page 2
findings.explanation: The entry mentions an AI tool but the narrative does not carry the client's disclosure marker "[AI-assisted]".
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm with the timekeeper whether AI assistance was used. If so, add "[AI-assisted]" to the entry.

findings.entry_narrative: Internal conference with team regarding claim construction strategy
findings.source_quote: Internal conferences among your team are capped at 0.5 hour per entry.
findings.explanation: Internal conference of 1.1 hours (read from "Internal conference"). The limit is 0.5 hours per entry.
findings.suggested_fix: Reduce the entry to the limit, or ask the client to approve the longer conference.

findings.source_quote: Narratives must say what was done and for what purpose; entries like "review documents" or "attention to file" are not enough.
findings.explanation: The description does not say what was done. It is only "Review documents", with no subject or purpose.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to say what was reviewed or done and for what purpose. Do not fill this in for them.

findings.entry_narrative: Review prior art references cited by examiner, draft claim amendments, and telephone conference with inventor regarding embodiments
findings.source_quote: Entries that lump several tasks together under one time total will be sent back.
findings.explanation: The narrative appears to describe 3 tasks under one time total of 3.1 hours.
findings.suggested_fix: Ask the timekeeper to enter each task on its own line with its own time. Tasks the check detected: (1) Review prior art references cited by examiner. (2) draft claim amendments. (3) telephone conference with inventor regarding embodiments. The tool does not know how the time divides between them and does not rewrite the narrative.

findings.entry_narrative: Draft proposed claim constructions for disputed terms
findings.source_quote: Rates are fixed by the engagement rate card for the calendar year and may not be exceeded.
findings.explanation: Billed at $440.00 an hour. The approved rate for this timekeeper is $420.00.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the rate to the approved rate card, or attach the client's approval of the higher rate.

summary: Draft invoice INV-L-4001 for Luminqa Data Systems (matter LDS-IP-014) totals $16,576.00 across 25 lines. The check ran 9 confirmed client rules plus the arithmetic checks. It found 9 open findings on 9 lines: 5 will likely be rejected, 4 likely reduced and 0 for review. The amount at risk is $4,772.00, or 28.8% of the invoice, counting each line once at its largest single reduction. The most frequent issue is AI-assisted work must be disclosed on the invoice (2 findings). Every finding is a prompt for review; nothing on the bill has been changed.
